items.behaviour: Ask Holly to disconnect an account, change billing, export data, remove a person, hand over ownership or delete the workspace, and she names the exact page for it.
steps: The owner's ownPageFor gives disconnect → Connections /dashboard/settings#connections-accounts
billing → Billing /dashboard/settings#account-billing
export → Privacy and export /dashboard/settings#privacy-export
remove_person and transfer_ownership → Access /dashboard/access
delete_workspace → Danger Zone /dashboard/settings#danger-zone
every href passes isAppPath
showOwnPageEntry.tier is 'free' and CATALOGUE offers show_own_page
the receipt reads 'That’s done on its own page.'

items.behaviour: If my role can't make the change, Holly's button goes to Access and says who does it. She never says she can't.
steps: A member asking delete_workspace or transfer_ownership gets Access /dashboard/access and 'Your workspace owner does this.'
a member asking remove_person gets 'Your workspace owner or an admin does this.'
an admin asking transfer_ownership or delete_workspace gets 'Your workspace owner does this; Access shows who that is.'
an admin asking remove_person is permitted and gets /dashboard/access
a member asking billing, export or disconnect is permitted
no receipt matches /can['’]?t|cannot|unable|not allowed/i

items.behaviour: The page link is a real button and stays beside Holly's answer.
steps: answered-turn keeps a receipt whose destination has asButton: true and still drops the same receipt without it
parseThreadBlock keeps asButton on a stored show_own_page receipt for all six asks
in an answered turn HollyThread draws the link Billing with href /dashboard/settings#account-billing as a HollyButton (class border-[1px])
an unflagged destination is still an underlined link

items.behaviour: Each of the six asks gets a button, takes no action and refuses nothing, held by an eval.
steps: OWN_PAGE_SET has six synthetic cases
each runs show_own_page then answer
keptButton(href) finds the flagged destination beside the answer
nothingRefused, noReceiptSaid(can't pattern), pressedNothing and endedWith('answered') all pass
the grader's own red cases fail: an unflagged destination fails keptButton, and 'I can't do that' fails noReceiptSaid
baseline.json own-page is 6/0/6
